name: dbg_shadow
eval: (async()=>{const g=window.__wl.game; const T=g.world.terrain; const THREE=await import('three'); const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(4,8,4), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x888888})); m.position.set(20,T.height(20,-40)+4,-40); m.castShadow=true; m.receiveShadow=true; g.scene.add(m); window.__dbgInfo = {light: g.world.sky.light.position.toArray(), target: g.world.sky.light.target.position.toArray(), int: g.world.sky.light.intensity, cam: [g.world.sky.light.shadow.camera.left, g.world.sky.light.shadow.camera.right], layers: g.world.sky.light.shadow.camera.layers.mask};})()
